rationale: Playbook PG-EXF-002 matched on alert ALRT-0003. The principal priya.suryani@eproc.test operating as database role analyst_ro read 1 statements against public.contracts between 2026-08-05T04:30:00Z and 2026-08-05T04:40:00Z. The standing playbook for bulk sensitive reads revokes the read grant that was used, terminates the live backend, and preserves the statement sample for the investigator.
rollback:

DELETE FROM incident_hold WHERE alert_id = 'ALRT-0003';

alert_summary.rule_name: Bulk export via COPY TO STDOUT

evidence.statement: COPY (SELECT contract_id, tender_id, vendor_id, awarded_amount, status FROM contracts) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER
COPY (SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, risk_rating FROM vendors) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER

baseline_context.note: Role analyst_ro normally returns about 3947 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
